Record Class Placement

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Record
be.imgn.swing.docking.Placement
Record Components:
target - the class of the target view, or null for the whole dock
region - where the view goes
proportion - the view's share of the space, strictly between 0 and 1; a CENTER placement doesn't read it
public record Placement(@Nullable Class<? extends DockView> target, DockRegion region, double proportion) extends Record
Where Dock.open(Class, Placement) docks a view: against a target, the open view of the target class opened last, or, when target is null or no view of it is open, the whole dock.
  • DockRegion.CENTER adds the view as the last tab of the target's tab group, and selects it. Against the whole dock, the target is the active view's tab group; in an empty dock, the view fills it.
  • The other regions split the target, a tab group or the whole dock's arrangement, in two: the view, in a tab group of its own, takes proportion of the space, on that side, and the target the rest. In an empty dock, the view fills it.
